title: Elephant wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#8f9bb0'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='26' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7c8799'/>
    <rect x='39' y='82' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#a3aec2'/>
    <rect x='52' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7c8799'/>
    <rect x='64' y='82' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#a3aec2'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='19' fill='#a3aec2'/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#7c8799'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#c9a3b8'/>
    <!-- trunk -->
    <path d='M82 50 q10 6 6 16 q-3 8 -10 8' stroke='#a3aec2' stroke-width='11' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M82 50 q10 6 6 16 q-3 8 -10 8' stroke='#8f9bb0' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='5' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
    <circle cx='73.5' cy='38.5' r='1.8' fill='#e8f2ff'/>
    <!-- tusk -->
    <path d='M78 55 q4 4 2 8' stroke='#f2ede0' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- party hat -->
    <path d='M58 30 L70 6 L82 30 Z' fill='#ff5f7e'/>
    <path d='M62 24 L78 24' stroke='#ffd84d' stroke-width='3'/>
    <path d='M65 17 L75 17' stroke='#4dd0e1' stroke-width='3'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='6' r='4' fill='#ffd84d'/>
    <path d='M58 30 q12 5 24 0' stroke='#ffd84d' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  </g>
</svg>
